items.notes: Checksum validation passed for the separated MovieLens package.

items.title: Freeze sample-generalization contract
items.notes: Four primary samplers, frozen chronological target, fixed controls, and independent-draw design are recorded.

items.title: Run full candidate matrix
items.notes: Executed 4 schemes × 3 models × 7 fractions; 732 draw rows, 84 aggregate rows, six figures, and exact full-reference checks.
Reviewed fixed-frame error, native-exclusion gaps, support coverage, ordering stability, and local resource measurements in the executed report.

items.title: Run fixed-cohort local-data budget replay
items.notes: Executed one real MovieLens chronological replay with a four-model control: 2,000 fixed users, 48 policy/model rows. The item-tail reserve cap is rejected; deterministic item-item cosine (NDCG@10 0.1155) shows no significant mean penalty down to one collection event per client, while implicit ALS stays below its 0.0419 same-data seed floor.
